messages:
mina: Heads up — noticed ~12% p99 regression on decoder-heavy production traces after kernel-selector roll from last night. Canary shows same.

raj: Confirmed on my sample workload. CPU spin in decode stage, prefill completes faster but decode queue backs up.

lex: Gathering perf flame graphs now. Initial look: heavier kernel selection (int8 path) picked for mid-seqlen, but kernel launch latency increased. Also see KV eviction spikes.

natalie: KV cache eviction rate spiked from 2%->9% at 23:05 UTC. Possible cascading effect: longer decode means KV lifetime shorter.

mina: Paste of simplified perf snippet:
```
[prof] prefill: avg=12.2ms p95=28ms
[prof] decode: avg=9.8ms p95=95ms <-- heavy tail
[prof] kv: hit=0.87 evict/s=9
[trace] kernel_selector: chose q4_int8 for layer 6-10 (latency_cost+10)
```

raj: If decode tail is driving p99, maybe our token budget assignment favors prefill too aggressively. Current config: token_budget_total=1024 token_budget_prefill=800

lex: Suggest experiment: split queues and enforce phase-aware token governors. Proposal:
- prefill queue target_tokens=600
- decode queue target_tokens=424
- if decode backlog > 8 requests, temporarily steal 100 tokens from prefill for 30s
- lower kernel_selector aggressiveness for int8 on decode-heavy traces

natalie: Also throttle KV background evictions: raise kv_cache_ttl and delay async flushes during high decode load.

mina: I'll run a canary with these params on the current cluster. Pushing a config patch now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary group=5% cfg=phase-split-token-governor-2026-03-17

lex: FYI flame graphs attached (link): https://perf.internal/runs/1764129123

raj: After 20 min into canary — p99 down ~6% and evictions reduced. Still seeing occasional spikes at ~2am UTC.

mina: Good. If stable for 2h, escalate to 25% rollout. Keep KV throttle conservative.

ops-bot: canary health: 5% OK, 1 failure (OOM guard triggered) — investigating.

natalie: OOM on one host traced to batch formation glue that sometimes creates 4x larger batch for prefill when small decode backlog present. Adding max_batch_size cap=32 for prefill.

mina: Updated config, redeploying canary.

deploy-bot: canary update complete. group=5% cfg=phase-split-token-governor-v2

raj: After cap and KV tweak — p99 down to baseline -1%. Looks promising. Plan to roll to 50% in 1h if no regressions.

lex: Follow-up: create perf regression test that simulates decode-heavy chat with KV hot keys and assert p99 < baseline+2%.

mina: Adding e2e perf test to CI and a dashboard alert for kv_evict_rate and decode_queue_latency p95/p99.

natalie: Nice. I'll also validate kernel_selector telemetry for layer assignment distribution.

mina: Thanks all. Documenting config diffs in the runbook: https://go/runbooks/phase-split-token-governor

raj: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout to 25% scheduled at 1764132723
